en.explanation: This is funny because it gives a mundane appliance human-like, annoying behavior, highlighting the intrusive and often unnecessary 'intelligence' of modern tech.

people.name: Jim Shooter
people.extract: James Charles Shooter was an American writer, editor and publisher in the comics industry. Beginning his career writing for DC Comics at the age of 14, he had a successful but controversial run as editor-in-chief at Marvel Comics, and launched comics publishers Valiant, Defiant, and Broadway.
highlights: Began writing for DC Comics at age 14.
Launched Valiant, Defiant, and Broadway comics publishers.

people.name: Paul Reichmann
people.extract: Paul Reichmann was a Canadian businessman and member of the Reichmann family. He is best known for his leadership of the Olympia & York real estate development company.
highlights: Led Olympia & York real estate development company.
